baseline.reason: On a policy refusal the incumbent settles the selection failure without restoring the signal mask at all: its handled signals are blocked only by the pre-launch `block_and_check`, which a refusal never reaches, so the final mask restore the row faults is not performed on this path. The same fixture selecting the site on a refusal reaches nothing and ends with the refusal's own exit 3, and it reaches the same site on the spawn-ENOENT path (hosted).
baseline.missing: a final signal-mask restore on the selection-refusal path (the incumbent neither blocks nor restores the mask there)
